function.name: add_node
function.description: Add a step to the agent. A new node isn't connected to anything: add an edge to it (add_edge) so the conversation can reach it.

task_message.description: What the agent does at this step, written as an instruction to the LLM.

end.description: True if the call ends after this step. A node with no outgoing edges must end the call.

role_message.description: Optional: replaces the agent-wide persona for this step only.

function.name: update_node
function.description: Change a node. Renaming keeps the edges that point at it. Only the fields given change.

role_message.description: Empty string to go back to the agent-wide persona.

function.name: delete_node
function.description: Delete a node and its edges. Nodes that could then no longer be reached from the start node are deleted too. The start node can't be deleted.

function.name: add_edge
function.description: Add a transition out of a node. The LLM running the agent takes it when the caller's reply matches its description. Several edges out of one node branch on what the caller says.

from.description: Name of the node the edge leaves.

function.description: snake_case function name, unique among this node's edges, e.g. cancel_appointment.

description.description: When to take this edge, e.g. 'The caller wants to cancel an appointment.'

to.description: Name of the node it leads to.

fields.description: Optional: values the LLM collects from the caller when taking the edge.

function.name: update_edge
function.description: Change an edge, found by the node it leaves and its function name. Only the fields given change; 'fields' replaces all of the edge's fields.

to.description: Name of the node it should lead to instead.

function.name: delete_edge
function.description: Delete an edge. Nodes that could then no longer be reached from the start node are deleted too.

function.name: set_start_node
function.description: Make another node the one the conversation starts at.

function.name: update_agent
function.description: Change the agent's name or its persona (the role message every node uses unless it has its own).

function.name: replace_agent
function.description: Replace the whole agent with a new one. Use it to build an agent from scratch or for a rewrite that touches most nodes; prefer the smaller tools for targeted changes.

agent.description: The full agent in the same JSON format as the current agent you're shown (name, persona, initial_node, nodes with task_messages, edges and end). Keep voice_id and model as they are unless asked.
